desc: 整箱囤货、翻盖单抽取用、换洗台与餐椅清洁场景的婴儿湿巾套图
leaf: 无香纯水婴儿湿巾大包装囤货装
name: 无香纯水婴儿湿巾囤货款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：整箱加一列叠放的软包直接说明囤货量级，白底合规无字。
一秒给出情感利益：以怀抱新生儿的手部与肩颈以下特写承接无香亲肤定位，产品退到画面下缘。
放大一次抽出多片浪费与餐后脏污擦不净的日常摩擦，让买家在右格里看到解法。
用掀盖取片的结构瞬间证明一次只出一片的取用逻辑，替代文字卖点。
微距压纹与纤维质感替代功效话术，用可实拍细节承载亲肤信任。
把产品放进真实的换洗动线里，用颈部以下的婴儿与护理手部完成代入。
保留两栏划删式不含清单的排版骨架，全部词目留空由后端按真实配方填。
覆盖喂饭后的第二使用场景，用背影与侧下颌代替童模正脸完成代入。
消除到货风险：一体成型的封箱胶带与无印刷箱面证明整箱直发、未拆封。
保留双箱并列与互换箭头的可选结构，具体版本差异交由后端填空说明。
以三档递增堆量收口囤货决策，档位圈与按钮全留空，价格与优惠一律不渲染。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless clean white #FFFFFF field for the packshot and the sealed carton screen, soft mint #EAF3F1 ground for benefit and variant screens, matte warm putty #F4F0E9 board for list and pain-point screens, pale sage plaster #E4EDE9 for the kitchen scene, mint terry #DCEAE6 for the care-mat scene, and one deep spring-teal #2E8C86 field reserved for the closing screen; all grounds stay flat, matte and untextured, no gradients and no stock backdrops
style.direction: clean gentle baby care commerce, soft mint nursery still life and real caregiving moments
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons and empty hairline rings in #D8B450, at most one emblem per screen, no filled badge artwork and no seal illustrations
style.lightingSystem: bright high-key soft studio light, key at front-left or upper-left around 5500K, white fill card on the shadow side, gentle wrapping shadows, one real contact shadow under every standing unit, no harsh speculars and no straight-down flash
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean gentle baby care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, soft mint #EAF3F1, matte warm putty #F4F0E9 and one spring-teal accent #2E8C86 with a hairline gold #D8B450 detail; neutral high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, a white fill card and real contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif used only in post, no lettering rendered inside the image; thin single-weight line icons and empty hairline rings; clean high-end baby care product photography mixed with minimal empty infographic frames; stable slight 3/4 or straight-on product identity and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no fabricated badges.
noDrift: no invented badges, seals or award marks
no rendered lettering, digits or prices inside the image
style.presentationRules: the pack keeps the same slight 3/4 or straight-on identity across the set, standing units always grounded by a contact shadow, opened lids always facing the lens, product never covered by hands or props, infant always framed from the neck down or from behind
style.surfaceSystem: matte plaster counter tones #EFE7DD, pale beech tray wood, soft cotton terry #DCEAE6 and natural kraft fibre #C8A87C; every surface reads matte, never glossy
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif kept for post-production only; the template renders no lettering at all, every copy slot stays an empty placeholder shape
